title: Validate complete PR #5757 replay on Linux: 2.60x faster with full coverage
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independently qualify [PR #5757's complete selected P104 replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5757) on Linux. Six alternating fresh processes reduce median wall time from **339.49 to 130.58 seconds: 2.60x faster, or 61.54% less time**. Every complete scientific stdout hash agrees. The original full RESULT/WORD comparisons, native phases, physical caller, complete invoice, compiler, outer checks and rejection controls run unchanged.

Timed peak kernel RSS increases from at most **475.05 to 492.72 MiB**. Normal qualification of both original registered scientific commands takes **402.88 seconds**; separate optimized qualification takes **404.05 seconds**. This extra literal-oracle work is outside the 2.60x timing claim. All ten scientific commands pass; no source bytes or permissions change.

This is verification engineering. Conditional κ remains `.00310045` and the five framework assumptions remain. The κ construction campaign stays paused.

## Task and overlap

Refine `replay-runtime` to Linux qualification of exact PR5757 head `53006fe6031dab5c23d5b7d1cf6a92f411a04a68`. Canonical main is `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority 8. The [released source investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5748) explicitly left Linux measurements open. [Our bounded claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5757#issuecomment-6430625161) preceded the runs. Targeted pre-submission overlap found no competing PR referring to this source; coverage is bounded.

The scientific contribution is one isolated 59-file package. The branch also carries the exact three-file test repair from [PR #5761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761), with Ali Romman’s authorship and source commit preserved. It retains the original official 54-file source export, 31 live inputs and original notices without changing the engine or source proof. The original pending Git head is not needed at runtime. Scientific evidence commit: `5195ab6d93425bb47b2bb8f9acba05d2ae307413`. Current PR head, including the test-only CI dependency: `dd59757bd1d938e2aed75e73f24e7ae7b8054211`.

## Validation

Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS, Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.3, Intel Core i7-4790. Literal timings are **349.64, 331.02, 339.49 seconds**; quadratic timings are **130.58, 127.27, 132.14 seconds**, in literal/quadratic/quadratic/literal/literal/quadratic order. Fresh processes, warm OS caches, variable host load; no sample is discarded.

Both normal and optimized full adapter checks pass. Both normal and optimized actual-state oracles compare all **17,651 distinct inputs and 9,037,312 amplitude entries per original literal interpreter**, including zeros and denominators. Their complete outputs agree byte-for-byte. All thirteen source assertions remain explicit failures in the derived compiler; independent AST inspection finds none inside the replaced state method.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-quadratic-linux-validation
```

This short registered command checks recorded evidence and source custody, with **17 synthetic evidence rejections and three actual source-entry corruption controls**. It does not launch the expensive positive scientific experiment. Complete cold reproduction is explicit:

```sh
python3.12 -B research/selected-quadratic-linux-validation/reproduce.py all --workdir /tmp/pr5757-linux-fresh
```

The original guarded phases took **2,217.07 seconds total**, with 600 seconds per command, sampled aggregate process-group RSS capped at 1 GiB, and a 4,500-second shared budget. No stop or retry occurred. The official export integrity/input checks, exact committed bytes/modes and immediate pin ancestry pass. The optimized recorded-evidence checks also pass from a Git-free, read-only export with empty PATH and all 60 files/modes unchanged. Full-history ancestry preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout.

Hosted CI is separate. The initial run failed on revision-8 catalogue expectations in unchanged shared assignment tests. Commit `dd59757bd1d938e2aed75e73f24e7ae7b8054211` cherry-picks [PR #5761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5761) at `ba8a9e640e1983f3c29993fefa3f46e8ed03313a`: it preserves legacy cases as explicit frozen fixtures and independently checks current catalogue routing. All 28 focused normal assignment tests and 12 optimized current-assignment tests pass locally; recorded-evidence controls and exact committed bytes/modes pass. All 59 scientific package files are unchanged. [The updated hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40434259033) reports CI separately. Details, raw outputs, resource measurements, proof coverage and limitations are in the package README, RESULT and evidence directory.

## Credit

Ali Romman supplied PR5757, the [PR #5704 quadratic engine](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5704), original proofs/controls and macOS measurements. Retain the [PR #5599 construction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599), native/controller/compiler/helper/BIT and classical stabilizer lineage in NOTICE and the unchanged source export. New Linux execution, review, reproduction and evidence checks were prepared for Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No subagents or independent human/proof-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Review whether this opt-in acceleration is ready for adoption after its existing mathematical obligations are checked. Any newer word needs a new source/consumer binding and full output/control comparison. Reducing repeated oracle cost needs a precise dependency and invalidation contract; cached PASS results are insufficient. This submission releases the bounded Linux qualification scope and resumes no κ research.
